senses.sense_definition: An industrial plant or facility that separates atmospheric air into its primary components, such as nitrogen and oxygen; abbreviation of air separation unit.

examples.text: The industrial plant installed a new <w>ASU</w> to produce high-purity oxygen on site.
Engineers scheduled routine maintenance for the primary cryogenic <w>ASU</w> next month.

senses.sense_definition: Arizona State University, a public research university located in the Phoenix metropolitan area.

examples.text: She decided to study journalism at <w>ASU</w> after visiting the main campus.
Thousands of excited alumni returned to <w>ASU</w> for the annual homecoming game.

senses.sense_definition: Appalachian State University, a public university located in Boone, North Carolina.

examples.text: He applied to <w>ASU</w> primarily because he loved the Blue Ridge Mountains.
Many students at <w>ASU</w> participate in outdoor recreation clubs every weekend.

senses.sense_definition: Alabama State University, a public historically black university located in Montgomery, Alabama.

examples.text: She graduated with honors from <w>ASU</w> with a degree in education.
The marching band at <w>ASU</w> is known nationwide for its performances.

senses.sense_definition: A critically endangered Nupoid language historically spoken in central Nigeria.

examples.text: Linguists conducted field research to document <w>Asu</w> before it became extinct.
Only a handful of elderly speakers still remember words in <w>Asu</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A Bantu language spoken by the Pare people in northeastern Tanzania.

examples.text: The linguist published a comprehensive grammatical sketch of the <w>Asu</w> language.
Stories and oral histories are still passed down to children in <w>Asu</w>.
